Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. INGREDIENTS  2 tbsp butter  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  1 small onion, chopped  1 tbsp Au Jus Gravy seasoning  1 tbsp Ranch Seasoning 1/2 tsp each of black pepper, and smoked paprika 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup banana peppers or Pepperoncinis  1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed  2 cups chicken broth Shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
